name: manual_c66086
claim: When asked to fix a specific CodeRabbit review finding by URL/ID, fetch that exact review's comments and diff against the PR's CURRENT head before writing any code -- a relayed finding is frequently already resolved (the repo owner or another agent fixed it since the finding was captured), and CodeRabbit itself posts an 'Addressed in commit <sha>' confirmation directly in the comment thread when that happens. Check for that confirmation and verify the cited commit is actually reachable from current HEAD before assuming work remains.

decisions.notes: 2026-09-12: given 3 explicit CodeRabbit fix requests across oramasys/oramasys#6, oramasys/agate#2, oramasys/perpetua-core#4. All 3 were already fixed and CodeRabbit-confirmed at each PR's current HEAD -- verified via git log/API rather than blindly re-applying the pasted diffs, which would have been redundant no-op commits at best and a conflicting/stale-base edit at worst.
